chapter: Fellow musicians and brass band world
title: Bunk Johnson and trombonist Maurice Durand
summary: Poree recalls Bunk Johnson, and says Bunk's trombonist Durand later worked with Sidney Durand.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Tommy, didn't you mention to me once that you remember Bunk Johnson? Yeah. Remember Bunk Johnson?
Yeah, I told him I remember Bunk Johnson.
You were asleep. Once so, I was asleep.
Yeah. Yeah. I remember Bunk Johnson. Yeah.
I remember Bunk Johnson. Yeah. Yeah. I remember Bunk Johnson.

Bunk Johnson had another nice trombone player, Maurice Duran. He was a nice trombone player. Who did he play? He was away from me a long time too. He came back and I think he did some work with Sidney Duran after he came back here.
Did you ever work with Sidney Duran? I did. I did. I did.
